description: This file contains the implementation of the ProjectRepository interface, providing methods to find, save, and remove Project objects, with dependencies on ProjectDao for database interactions.

classes.name: ProjectRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProjectRepository interface, acts as a repository layer interacting with ProjectDao to perform CRUD operations on Project entities.

methods.name: findProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project by its projectId using ProjectDao.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Saves a Project entity through ProjectDao.

methods.name: removeProject
methods.description: Removes a Project by its projectId via ProjectDao.
